aboutPage.storyHeading: The Athugala Citadel & Secret Royal Formulations
aboutPage.storyP1: During the illustrious reign of King Parakramabahu IV in the Citadel of Athugalpura (Kurunegala), court physicians formulated sacred herbal compounds and protective yantra shields for the protection of royalty and the realm. These secret palm-leaf manuscripts were passed down in strict oral and hereditary disciple lineages.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today, under the sanctified mantle of Athugalpura Osu Veda Madura, we open this royal treasury to patrons and devotees worldwide. Every herbal elixir, antique brass Vajrayudha, and protective talisman is forged and consecrated in accordance with auspicious planetary hours and traditional guru lineages.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: Zero artificial compounds. Exclusively utilizing 108 wild-foraged sacred herbs sourced responsibly across pristine Sri Lankan sanctuaries.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: Every talisman is energized through 108 continuous mantra recitations during rare celestial alignments such as Amrita Siddhi Yoga and Poya Full Moons.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: Each relic is stamped with the Royal Kandyan Tusker seal and registered in our immutable archival ledger with a serialized tamper-proof certificate.
aboutPage.founderRole: Senior Ayurvedic Doctors & Temple Tantrik Masters
aboutPage.founderDesc: Led by hereditary masters with over 40 years of dedication to Nadi pulse diagnostics, sacred metallurgy, and consecrated esoteric sciences.
